$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: An actor's event
description: Something an actor did: came or went, changed what it's doing, spawned a session, edited, ran a command, messaged someone, said something, finished or failed.

id.description: Unique for the actor, such as wren:41

actor.description: actor:<slug>, or @<host>:actor:<slug> from another host; the person at the console is actor:you

target.description: A graph node id, an actor id, or null

detail.description: What and where, written by XenoNet from facts: never the text of a message or a conversation, and never a secret

via.description: observed: XenoNet reads its state; attributed: XenoNet traces work here back to it; registered: it reports itself; remote: it reads through a connection you approved; demo: made up
